title: The scratch file of the first supervised run has a second line
goal: kb/_self/reports/autopilot-throwaway.md keeps its heading and first sentence and gains a second sentence saying a second item added it after the first landed; nothing else in the repository changes

run: import pathlib,sys; t=pathlib.Path("kb/_self/reports/autopilot-throwaway.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8"); sys.exit(0 if t.startswith("# Autopilot throwaway") and "scratch file" in t and "second item" in t else 1)
